title: China Building Materials Industry Key Laboratory of Aerogel Materials, Nanjing Tech University
content:
The China Building Materials Industry Key Laboratory of Aerogel Materials is an industry key laboratory under the China Building Materials Federation system, based at Nanjing Tech University's College of Materials Science and Engineering, home to one of China's most established aerogel research groups, active since about 2000.

The laboratory focuses on silica aerogels and their composites: network structure control, high-temperature hydrophobic aerogels, fiber-composite blankets and low-cost scalable drying routes. Applications span industrial and aerospace thermal protection, building insulation composites, and thin aerogel sheets for lithium-ion battery thermal management. Its researchers organise international aerogel conferences and have transferred technologies to manufacturers.

It offers buyers aerogel formulation, composite development and testing partnerships.
excerpt: Nanjing Tech University aerogel key laboratory researching silica aerogel composites for construction, industrial, aerospace and EV battery insulation.
